title: Cheese Grits
ingredients: 2 oz. grated sharp white cheddar cheese
instructions: Add the water, heavy cream, and butter to a medium sauce pan and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, turn down the heat to medium-low and stir in the grits.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes, stirring regularly.
When the grits have a thick consistency, turn the heat off and fold in the cheese.
